items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: But poor Jimmy, he said, 'Helen you know I don't drink no more. We got to work together'.

ctx.x: But you know, a lot of guys like that, they just figure they're more comfortable and they are enjoying themselves more when they keep on having a little drink, a little drink, and so.
Yeah. And one of my favorite piano players is Jimmy Rowles.
